```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(colf)
library(ggthemes)
library(Metrics)
source(here("helper/joint_scaling.R"))

adult_bd <- read_csv(here("adults/adult_exposure_duration.csv"))
infant_bd <- read_csv(here("infants/data/infant_exposure_duration.csv"))%>% filter(fam_or_test == 'test', !exclude)

adult_resnet50_eig <- read_csv(here("simulations/sim_adult_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_resnet50_eig.csv"))
infant_resnet50_eig <- read_csv(here("simulations/sim_infant_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_resnet50_eig.csv"))

infant_resnet50_eig <- infant_resnet50_eig %>% filter(!(trial_number == 1 & trial_type == 'deviant')) %>% renaming()

```

```{r}
fit_df = run_joint_fit(adult_d = adult_bd, infant_d = infant_bd, adult_sim = adult_resnet50_eig, infant_sim = infant_resnet50_eig)

write_csv(fit_df, "cached_data/joint_scaling_df.csv")

fit_df = read_csv("cached_data/joint_scaling_df.csv")

# best adult param
adult_param = fit_df %>% arrange(-rsquared) %>% first() %>% pull(p_a)

# best infant_param
infant_param = fit_df %>% arrange(-rsquared) %>% first() %>% pull(p_i)

param_info <- read_csv(here("simulations/sim_adult_exposure_duration/param_info/param_info_resnet50_eig.csv"))
fit_df = fit_df %>% rename(param_id = p_a) %>% left_join(param_info %>% select(param_id, V_prior, alpha_prior, beta_prior, sd_epsilon, world_EIGs), by = "param_id" ) %>%  mutate(across(-c(rsquared,rmse), as.factor))

ggplot(fit_df, aes(x = rmse, fill = world_EIGs)) + geom_histogram()

ggplot(fit_df, aes(x = rmse)) + geom_histogram()


```
